verdict.rationale: Lithic is an API-first platform described as a 'predictable and programmatic interface,' so it runs headlessly by design. Its sandbox mirrors production and lets you run cards, transactions, and webhooks end-to-end, with simulation endpoints for acquirer-originated authorization events, which supports automated test pipelines. Dated api-version headers keep automated integrations stable. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD guidance or examples, an official CLI or headless tooling, a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
